problem: Portal intelligence surfaces could navigate to actions without persisting the user's action intent into the canonical Brain loop.
rootCause: The next-gen UI emitted insight evidence but the action controls only changed portal navigation, leaving the canonical Action stage absent from that user interaction lineage.

preventionRule: Every Portal V2 intelligence control that says or implies Act/Create action must emit one authenticated idempotent Brain Action on the same correlation lineage before or alongside navigation, followed by canonical runtime readback.
prevention: Use the existing authenticated /api/brain-operating-loop authority; do not create a parallel action store.
Persist action intent as Brain type Action with REQUESTED status and executed=false.
Link the Action to the latest same-lineage interaction record when available.
Refresh canonical Brain projection after the Action write.
Keep action context bounded and do not infer hidden source values.

evaluation.expected: A portal action control persists exactly one canonical REQUESTED Action with tenant auth and same-lineage correlation, then refreshes Brain readback.
